player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I entered a loop between the Kitchen and the Billiard room, repeatedly visiting the same nodes without checking if all rooms had been visited. I stopped prematurely upon returning to the start, assuming the task was complete. Next time, I will maintain a mental (or explicit) list of visited rooms. Whenever I return to a previously visited room, I will immediately check if the list contains all unique rooms encountered so far. Only if the list is complete will I output "DONE"; otherwise, I will choose an untried direction from the current room's available options to continue exploring.
